description: React component for a modal dialog to set or modify dashboard refresh intervals in Apache Superset, including UI elements, state management, and warning messages.

classes.name: RefreshIntervalModal
classes.description: React functional component implementing a modal for setting dashboard refresh intervals.

methods.name: handleFrequencyChange
methods.description: Updates the refresh frequency state when user selects a new value.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the new refresh interval, closes modal, and shows success toast.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Resets refresh frequency to initial value and closes modal without saving.
